name: Tenmei (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tenmei town emblem in white: a stylised angular device of horizontal strokes, like a letter Z.
history: Flag of the former town of Tenmei in Kumamoto Prefecture, dissolved on 1991-02-01. The municipal emblem was adopted in September 1975.

features.role: Tenmei town emblem — a stylised angular device of horizontal strokes, like a letter Z
